# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.8.0

Version 1.8.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.7.0

**The full touch mode held upright.** Turn the phone to portrait (Settings → Gameplay → Touch controls → Full touch)
and the game is laid out for it:

- The 3D fills the screen, drawn closer, from a camera a little lower and nearer than the game's (outside 34 degrees
  above the ground instead of 45; rooms a little lower too).
- The message window sits at the top, larger, under the icons, with the speaker's name over it.
- The answers are big buttons at the bottom: tap one to pick it. (On the original disc, whose kana the port does not
  write out, the game's own answer window moves to the bottom, larger, and takes the taps.)
- The clock is at the bottom, what is under your feet at the top, the tools in a row of their own under the icons.
- A menu (the pockets, the map, letters, the catalog, ...) takes the screen's width in the middle, its keys in a
  row under it. Turn the phone back for bigger menus.
- The furniture mode's pockets row wraps into rows, the piece's name over them.

**Screen orientation**, a new setting under Touch controls on Android: turn with the phone (the default; with the
rotation lock on, the phone's way), always landscape or always upright. The on-screen pad and the touch-off modes stay
in landscape as before. On a PC, a window made taller than wide gets the same layout in the full touch mode.

Landscape is as in v1.7.0. A window taller than 4:3 outside the full touch mode now keeps the 2D's shape (a band in
the middle) and sees more above and below, instead of being stretched.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's to v1.7.0's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.8.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Played by script with touches on a 720x1560 window (a phone's shape), with the Korean patch unless said:

- **Talking**: a tap on a villager brought the message window at the top with the name over it, the answers as
  buttons at the bottom; a tap on the second button picked it and the talk ended. The title's talk showed its three
  answers as buttons. **The original disc**: the game's answer window at the bottom, a tap on its second row picked it.
- **Outside**: the camera at 34 degrees and 0.86 of the distance, the player in the middle, the tools under the
  icons, the clock at the bottom.
- **The pockets** opened by their icon, an item dragged to another slot moved; **the bank** with its ▲▼ keys under
  it; the map, the notice board, a letter, the catalog in the middle.
- **A room**: the camera's and the light's icons; **the furniture mode**: ten pieces in two rows, one dragged onto
  the floor (green under the finger) was placed, its name over the rows.
- The pause menu and the GameCube pad (from its icon) in the upright window.
- Landscape: the fifteen touch checks of v1.6.0 to v1.7.0, run on v1.7.0's release and on this version, log the same
  and give the same screenshots; the 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged
  positions and saves on v1.7.0 and on this version, touch off.
- All unit tests pass; the decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.8.0, versionCode 10800); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.7.0's.

## Known limitations

- Upright, the menus are the game's 4:3 pictures across the screen's width, so they are small on a phone; turn it for
  bigger ones.
- The upright layout was checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone; the turn itself
  (the activity's orientation) is Android's and was not tried on a device.
- With the Korean patch, Tom Nook's passwords cannot be typed (with a pad as well).
- The limitations of v1.7.0 and v1.6.x remain (see the [v1.7.0 notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.7.0)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
